D/ CRISPVS NOB CAES ; R/ BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Trier mint Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321, Reece period 16. In extremely good condition. RIC vol. 7 no. 324. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CRISPVS NOB CAES. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/X[X], star above. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS. In exergue: PTR.…
